Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7-A #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Storm RAMIL
Issued at: 6:40 PM, 19 October 2025(Sunday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales(Iba, Palauig, Candelaria, Masinloc, Santa Cruz).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Zambales(Olongapo, Subic, San Marcelino, Cabangan, Castillejos, San Antonio, San Felipe, San Narciso, Botolan), Nueva Ecija(Carranglan, Pantabangan, Bongabon, Lupao), Pampanga(Lubao, Floridablanca, Porac), Tarlac(Bamban, Capas, Mayantoc, San Jose, San Clemente, Camiling), Batangas(Nasugbu, Lian, Tuy, Balayan, Calatagan, Calaca) and Cavite(Maragondon, Ternate, Naic, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Magallanes, Alfonso).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Bulacan, Metro Manila, Quezon, Rizal, Laguna, Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, Gapan, General Tinio, San Antonio, San Isidro, Aliaga, Cabanatuan, Cuyapo, Gabaldon, General Mamerto Natividad, Guimba, Jaen, Laur, Licab, Llanera, Nampicuan, Palayan, Penaranda, Quezon, Rizal, San Jose, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Santo Domingo, Munoz, Talavera, Talugtug, Zaragoza), Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Moncada, Santa Ignacia), Pampanga(Sasmuan, Apalit, Arayat, Bacolor, Candaba, San Fernando, Macabebe, Magalang, Masantol, Mexico, Minalin, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana, Santo Tomas, Angeles, Mabalacat, Guagua, Santa Rita), Cavite(Amadeo, General Trias, Indang, Mendez, Silang, Tagaytay, Trece Martires, Bacoor, Carmona, Cavite City, Dasmarinas, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Imus, Kawit, Noveleta, Rosario, Tanza) and Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balete, Batangas City, Bauan, Tanauan, Cuenca, Ibaan, Laurel, Lemery, Lipa, Lobo, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Jose, San Juan, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Taysan, Tingloy) which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
